rationale: EO 13024 (November 7, 1996) only amended EO 12015 (student career experience appointments). EO 13562 of December 27, 2010, Sec. 8(b), provides that on the effective date of OPM final regulations implementing the Internship Program, Executive Order 12015, as amended, is superseded and revoked. The held OPM final rule (77 FR 28194, May 11, 2012, jobs/selden-fr-citers/output/texts/fr-2012-11068.txt) states it is effective July 10, 2012, so the parent order carrying the 13024 amendments was revoked on that date. The status is NO as of 2026-10-14; the final rule is not in the dossier evidence map, so the lifecycle sheet is blocked.
